claims.statement: The exact OPEN identity E993-BIPARTITE-TAGGED-SHADOW-BOUND holds: for every finite bipartite simple graph H, every W subset V(H), a=alpha(H), and every integer 1<=k<=a, if q_j counts independent j-subsets meeting W with zero extension, then k*q_(k+1)<=2(a-k)*q_k.
claims.scope: Exact registered auxiliary scope, including disconnected graphs, empty W, k=a, and integer counts; proved by a complete finite-set incidence argument, with no formal award claimed.
claims.reason: Each tagged (k+1)-set has at least k tag-preserving deletions. For a fixed tagged k-set J, the addable vertices A(J) induce a bipartite graph with alpha at most a-k because J is anticomplete to A(J); hence |A(J)|<=2(a-k). Double-count incidences. Exact connected P4 equality verifies non-strict sharpness. Independent finite checks include every bipartite graph on partitions up to 3+3 for the stated tag families and all ranks, plus K_11,13 at all ranks.

limitations: The proof is informal and does not claim a Lean or governed formal award.
The exhaustive check covers only 682 graphs of partition sizes 1..3 and the stated tag families; the larger exact check is K_11,13. Computation is not the universal proof.
The separate OPEN alpha>=7 eligibility claim is not proved here, so the conditional application does not establish the primary aggregate.
